Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Ianar Eshun: 38-year-old man, 150 cm (very-short), sturdy stocky construction with a broad frame and compact proportions, skin value band-2-light. Face: heart-shaped face; close-set eyes and a high arched brow; short rounded nose, wide mouth; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette ochre-cream. Visible personal details: one wide engraved hair cuff on one side, with no other hair or ear jewelry; one asymmetric ear cuff; a patterned collar insert. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance.
